## K1. Spread across endpoints

Only rows with nonzero measurements and available values at all compared endpoints enter AARD. The row spread is $100(\max y_c-\min y_c)/|y_o|$. AARD spread is max–min in percentage points. Column A gives the measured-data deviation of the manuscript endpoint on the same rows. For MDEA the spread uses both A continuations and LHS-53. The spreads describe these endpoints and observations. They do not quantify parameter uncertainty.

## K2. Parent assemblages and AMP controls

MEA: 2,483 of 2,484 liquid-grid states completed. The 162 L–V census cases returned 149 passed two-phase and 13 passed single-liquid parents. The measured-pressure screen completed 246 of 321 states.

## K3. DEA density at 298.15 K and assigned 101.325 kPa

Bulk density uses additive daughter volumes, $\rho=(\sum_i w_i/\rho_i)^{-1}$.

| Deposit ID | Processed source row | Measured | Single liquid | Two-liquid bulk |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 32 | 33 | 1094.00 | 1094.51 | 1094.08 |
| 41 | 42 | 1111.00 | 1109.90 | 1109.41 |
| 42 | 43 | 1119.00 | 1117.24 | 1116.42 |
| 43 | 44 | 1127.00 | 1125.32 | 1124.29 |

Densities are in kg/m³. AARD is 0.113% for the single liquid and 0.155% for the two-liquid bulk. Agreement of bulk densities alone does not identify the phases in the experiment.
